## Triage: cloud source for the mirror · 2026-11-15T14:14Z

⛔ Not a claim. This answers domain:skills#1's cloud-confirm request (mailbox comment 6895778759). The skills seat cannot read objectstack-ai/cloud, so the source text is copied here.

**Blocker cleared.** objectstack-ai/cloud#4466 closed completed at 2026-11-14T01:33Z through cloud PR #4474, merge sha `312f2e5efc83c73d2bc5fec5bed62e099d00e6f5`. The file is `docs/adr/0024-identity-and-access-architecture.md`. The card stays `pm:queue` · p1 · `domain:skills`.

**What to mirror.** Below are the two passages PR #4474 added that carry the decision, copied verbatim. The same PR also made smaller edits: it marked the D5.2 break-glass invariant, the D6 tiering text and the Phasing line "(hosted: superseded by the 2026-11-14 note, ruling 10; self-hosted unchanged)", and recorded cloud#500 as closed (completed) on 2026-06-27. Mirror at ADR-0135's granularity, with provenance "cloud ADR-0024, amended 2026-11-14, cloud#4465 rulings 7, 9 and 10, cloud PR #4474 @ 312f2e5e". The cloud record stays the decision; this is a governed path with a maintainer merge.

**1. The dated note (header list):**

> **Amended:** 2026-11-14 (maintainer ruling, card [cloud#4465](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/4465); refines the 2026-10-21 amendment, does not reverse it) — **hosted: credentials live in the cloud; the roster and authorization live in the environment.** Every person remains their own cloud account, and D5.1 is unchanged: the OP issues a code only to a `sys_member` of the environment's organization. What moves is who starts the lifecycle. An environment administrator adds, imports and deactivates people in Setup → Users. The environment asks the control plane to invite the address as `member`. Deactivating a plain member ends that membership; an owner or admin is changed in the console only. The request ends in better-auth's own `sys_invitation` / `sys_member` writes and passes every gate a console invitation passes (D9: no second invitation store, no cloud-side roster). For hosted, D5.2's `idp-provisioned` column reads: Admin add-user and Deactivate **in the environment**; Invite **sent by the cloud on the environment's request**; Password management still **none**. Unchanged: D1, self-hosted deployments, the console's own invitation. One authorization is projected from the cloud: an organization owner or admin holds `admin_full_access` in the environment while that role lasts (ruling 9). This is the only exception to D5; every other position and permission set is assigned in the environment, and nothing is projected upward. Hosted has no local break-glass admin; emergency access is a platform-operator procedure, and self-hosted deployments keep local admins (ruling 10). **Supersedes (only these; everything else in [cloud#3132](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3132) stands):** cloud#3132 ruling [6311479286](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3132#issuecomment-6311479286) item 2 (Setup → Users as a read-only user list with one line pointing to the organisation's invite); [cloud#3135](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3135)'s "one door" console copy, including the Team page's "there is no separate invitation inside an environment"; D5.2's hosted `idp-provisioned` column for Admin add-user and Deactivate (now as above); D5.2's hosted `idp-provisioned` Invite row ("up to org / IdP": the environment now initiates, and the cloud sends); D5.2's hosted "Identity attrs (email / name / active)" read-only mirror, as far as `active` goes (the environment may now deactivate); D4's `idp-provisioned` row, where identity is not editable in the environment, as far as the roster lifecycle goes (the environment now adds, imports and deactivates the person; credentials stay in the cloud); and, for hosted, the break-glass local admin that D5.2's invariant and the 2026-10-21 amendment kept — no hosted environment sets a local password for anyone, existing owner break-glass passwords are invalidated, and emergency access is audited, through the platform-admin `disable_platform_sso` / `enable_platform_sso` of [cloud#3134](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3134) or a one-time recovery link. **SCIM:** [cloud#500](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/500)'s cloud-to-environment fan-out is not needed under this model (D6: per production environment, not fan-out); if hosted ever offers bring-your-own IdP with SCIM, the customer's IdP provisions straight into the environment roster through the framework's SCIM path. Whether such a person also holds a cloud membership is decided with that offer. The D1–D10 bodies are not rewritten; for hosted deployments this note governs where they disagree.

**2. The correction under the D5.2 invariant:**

> **Correction (maintainer, 2026-11-14 — card [cloud#4465](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/4465) ruling 10; this note is card [cloud#4466](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/4466)):** hosted: superseded by the 2026-11-14 note, ruling 10; self-hosted unchanged. No hosted environment keeps a local admin login: existing owner break-glass passwords are invalidated, and emergency access is an audited platform-operator procedure (the platform-admin `disable_platform_sso` / `enable_platform_sso` of [cloud#3134](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3134), or a one-time recovery link). Self-hosted deployments keep the invariant as written above.

2026-11-16T09:37Z **The cloud ADR-0024 hosted identity note, verbatim, for the mirror.** This answers the Maintainer-action of 2026-11-15T14:16Z.

- **Source:** `objectstack-ai/cloud` `docs/adr/0024-identity-and-access-architecture.md`.
- **Merged by:** cloud PR #4474, merge commit **`312f2e5efc83c73d2bc5fec5bed62e099d00e6f5`** (2026-11-14T01:30Z).
- **Current:** that commit is still the last one to touch the file on cloud `origin/main`, read just now. So the text below is current.

Below are the lines that commit added or rewrote (it changed 5 existing lines and added the rest), verbatim. The edits to the existing 2026-10-21 amendment are marked inline with *(hosted: superseded by the 2026-11-14 note, ruling 10; …)*.

````markdown
- **Amended:** 2026-10-21 (maintainer ruling on [cloud#3132](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3132), letter A amended: 「云端环境就是受管模式，自托管模式不影响。」; first stage [cloud#3133](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3133)) — **D2's boundary** becomes 「hosted: every account is a cloud account; the environment holds authorization」 (the team-vs-end-user split retires for hosted deployments). **D6's SSO-only gate** moves from Business+ to the hosted default (the paid item is 「bring your own IdP / SCIM」). Unchanged: the break-glass local admin (D5.2's invariant) *(hosted: superseded by the 2026-11-14 note, ruling 10; self-hosted unchanged)* and self-hosted deployments (local accounts, `OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY` as an operator choice). The switch is `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` on the cloud's objectos containers, read by the framework's one accessor (objectstack-ai/objectstack#25083).
- **Amended:** 2026-11-14 (maintainer ruling, card [cloud#4465](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/4465); refines the 2026-10-21 amendment, does not reverse it) — **hosted: credentials live in the cloud; the roster and authorization live in the environment.** Every person remains their own cloud account, and D5.1 is unchanged: the OP issues a code only to a `sys_member` of the environment's organization. What moves is who starts the lifecycle. An environment administrator adds, imports and deactivates people in Setup → Users. The environment asks the control plane to invite the address as `member`. Deactivating a plain member ends that membership; an owner or admin is changed in the console only. The request ends in better-auth's own `sys_invitation` / `sys_member` writes and passes every gate a console invitation passes (D9: no second invitation store, no cloud-side roster). For hosted, D5.2's `idp-provisioned` column reads: Admin add-user and Deactivate **in the environment**; Invite **sent by the cloud on the environment's request**; Password management still **none**. Unchanged: D1, self-hosted deployments, the console's own invitation. One authorization is projected from the cloud: an organization owner or admin holds `admin_full_access` in the environment while that role lasts (ruling 9). This is the only exception to D5; every other position and permission set is assigned in the environment, and nothing is projected upward. Hosted has no local break-glass admin; emergency access is a platform-operator procedure, and self-hosted deployments keep local admins (ruling 10). **Supersedes (only these; everything else in [cloud#3132](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3132) stands):** cloud#3132 ruling [6311479286](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3132#issuecomment-6311479286) item 2 (Setup → Users as a read-only user list with one line pointing to the organisation's invite); [cloud#3135](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3135)'s "one door" console copy, including the Team page's "there is no separate invitation inside an environment"; D5.2's hosted `idp-provisioned` column for Admin add-user and Deactivate (now as above); D5.2's hosted `idp-provisioned` Invite row ("up to org / IdP": the environment now initiates, and the cloud sends); D5.2's hosted "Identity attrs (email / name / active)" read-only mirror, as far as `active` goes (the environment may now deactivate); D4's `idp-provisioned` row, where identity is not editable in the environment, as far as the roster lifecycle goes (the environment now adds, imports and deactivates the person; credentials stay in the cloud); and, for hosted, the break-glass local admin that D5.2's invariant and the 2026-10-21 amendment kept — no hosted environment sets a local password for anyone, existing owner break-glass passwords are invalidated, and emergency access is audited, through the platform-admin `disable_platform_sso` / `enable_platform_sso` of [cloud#3134](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3134) or a one-time recovery link. **SCIM:** [cloud#500](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/500)'s cloud-to-environment fan-out is not needed under this model (D6: per production environment, not fan-out); if hosted ever offers bring-your-own IdP with SCIM, the customer's IdP provisions straight into the environment roster through the framework's SCIM path. Whether such a person also holds a cloud membership is decided with that offer. The D1–D10 bodies are not rewritten; for hosted deployments this note governs where they disagree.
- **Phasing:** **V1 (Phase 1)** ships only the *protocol-connectivity* slice of D3 — cloud-as-OIDC-OP + env-as-configurable-OIDC-client + customer-configured per-env IdP; see [V1 — First implementable slice](#v1--first-implementable-slice-phase-1). The org-anchored membership model, the prod/dev metering split (moot since 2026-11-03 — the development type is retired, see the D10 amendment), and SCIM fan-out *(not needed — 2026-11-14 amendment above)* are **deferred to later phases**.
- **Subsumes:** the design in [cloud#500](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/500) (Enterprise Identity: SSO + SCIM fan-out). cloud#500 was closed (completed) on 2026-06-27 (corrected 2026-11-14: this line said it remained open as the implementation tracker); this ADR is its decision-of-record, and its cloud-to-environment SCIM fan-out is not needed under the 2026-11-14 amendment.
Federating an env to an IdP does **not** delete the env's local user-management — it **splits by population (D2)** and adapts by **mode (D6)**. Mainstream enterprise pattern (Salesforce / Slack / Atlassian / GitHub EMU): the IdP owns the **lifecycle**; the app keeps a **managed mirror + authorization**; a **break-glass local admin always survives** *(hosted: superseded by the 2026-11-14 amendment, ruling 10 — see the correction under the invariant below; self-hosted unchanged)*.
**Correction (maintainer, 2026-11-14 — card [cloud#4465](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/4465) ruling 10; this note is card [cloud#4466](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/4466)):** hosted: superseded by the 2026-11-14 note, ruling 10; self-hosted unchanged. No hosted environment keeps a local admin login: existing owner break-glass passwords are invalidated, and emergency access is an audited platform-operator procedure (the platform-admin `disable_platform_sso` / `enable_platform_sso` of [cloud#3134](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3134), or a one-time recovery link). Self-hosted deployments keep the invariant as written above.

| **Mode switch — `optional` / `enforced`** (require SSO; disable local password + self-registration for the *managed* population; break-glass policy) | **Business+** | **Governance, not "can you log in."** Free/Team have a fixed mode (cloud-as-IdP + env-native end-users + break-glass). *(Break-glass: hosted has none since the 2026-11-14 amendment, ruling 10; self-hosted unchanged.)* |
**Tiering refined (founder, 2026-06-26) — "free cloud SSO; paid bring-your-own + governance":** **Free/Team are LOCKED to cloud-as-IdP** (incl. **free social logins — Google / Microsoft**); they cannot bring their own IdP and have **no mode switch** (fixed: cloud-as-IdP for the team + env-native for end-users + a break-glass local admin *(hosted: none since the 2026-11-14 amendment, ruling 10)*). **Bring-your-own external IdP (OIDC + SAML) and the mode switch unlock at Business+**; **SCIM lifecycle + audit at Enterprise**. This **moves bring-your-own OIDC from Free+ to Business+**, adjusting the earlier no-SSO-tax wording — but it is **not** the criticized [sso.tax](https://sso.tax): Free/Team are **not denied SSO** (cloud-as-IdP + social, free), the **OSS self-host edition is unrestricted** (open mechanism stays free — the funnel), and gating concentrates the **support-heavy** IdP integrations in the paying tiers (decisive for a solo operator). Matches Airtable packaging (SSO-federation is Business+ there too), only more generous on the free tier. **Load-bearing condition:** cloud-as-IdP MUST ship **free social logins at Free/Team** — the pressure valve that keeps the gate painless. **Self-host is inherently custom** (you run your own auth / IdP; cloud-as-IdP does not apply, and the SSO mechanism is ungated). **Plan ruling B (maintainer, 2026-11-03, [cloud#3502](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3502#issuecomment-6595394251)):** Business left every cloud quote surface, so 「Business+」 in this paragraph and in the table above reads **Enterprise** from that date — both Enterprise deliveries, since the Enterprise 单机版 single-node license (ADR-0085 D4, renamed by the same ruling) keeps the bring-your-own IdP grant; the mode-switch row had already retired to the hosted default (2026-10-21 amendment above).
Org-anchored membership / invite = join-org / `sys_environment_member` narrowing to an authz projection; the prod/dev metering split (moot since 2026-11-03 — the development type is retired, see the D10 amendment); SCIM auto-provision/deprovision + group→role; org-level SSO/SCIM fan-out; the full D4 managed-vs-native write rules; **SAML validation** (the mechanism ships open in the SSO plugin — OIDC validated first); the D6 tiering-ladder enforcement. These remain **open** (see Open questions) and are tracked in cloud#500. *(historical: cloud#500 closed, completed, on 2026-06-27 — correction of 2026-11-14)*
The items below enumerate the **full-architecture** build-out (D1–D8); **V1 (Phase 1)** above is the subset that ships first. Tracked in [cloud#500](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/500). *(historical: cloud#500 closed, completed, on 2026-06-27 — correction of 2026-11-14)*
- **V1 is scoped above** (the protocol-connectivity slice of D3); later-phase sequencing lives in cloud#500. *(historical: cloud#500 closed, completed, on 2026-06-27 — correction of 2026-11-14)*
- **[cloud#500](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/500)** — Enterprise Identity: SSO + SCIM fan-out across an org's environments. **The implementation tracker this ADR subsumes** ~~(stays open)~~ *(closed, completed, on 2026-06-27 — correction of 2026-11-14; its cloud-to-environment fan-out is not needed under the 2026-11-14 amendment)*.
````

The cloud record stays the decision (governed path, maintainer merge). The mirror in `docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md` follows at its own granularity, with provenance to cloud#4465 and the sha above.
